title: Anti-Productive
statement: The task is to find the minimum number of unit decrements on an array (n up to 5·10^5, values and bound ℓ up to 10^9) so that no pair's product reaches ℓ. Only the two largest final values matter, so the second-largest is at most sqrt(ℓ). The solution brute-forces that cap up to sqrt(ℓ), clips every other element to it, and greedily lets the maximum keep up to ⌊(ℓ−1)/cap⌋.
